sources.sourceSummaryZhTw: 當前合眾 Pokédex 對 #584～#613 的 38 個 ordinary exact forms 全部明確標示 Released: Yes；四季鹿／萌芽鹿四季型態與輕飄飄／胖嘟嘟性別型態逐 form 列出。另明確標示 Mega Eelektross 與 Mega Chandelure 為 Released: No；本批沒有正面列出的 Dynamax／Gigantamax form。
現行 Shadow Pokémon 名單正面列出本批 Karrablast／Escavalier、Foongus／Amoonguss、Joltik／Galvantula、Ferroseed／Ferrothorn、Litwick／Lampent／Chandelure，共 11 個 ordinary exact forms；缺席者不反推為未推出。

sources.sourceTitleOriginal: A PvE Analysis of Flying Taxi: Taken Over
sources.sourceSummaryZhTw: 活動分析明確記錄 2026-06 Flying Taxi: Taken Over 的 Rocket Leader Cliff 使用 Shadow Axew，因此 Shadow 牙牙具正面推出證據；不把 PvPoke 的 Shadow ID 當作推出依據。

sources.sourceTitleOriginal: Can Shadow Pokémon learn Community Day moves when evolved?
sources.sourceSummaryZhTw: 官方明確說明 Shadow Pokémon 可以在符合條件時進化並取得社群日招式，因此已確認的 Shadow Axew 可安全沿同一進化線推導 Shadow Fraxure 與 Shadow Haxorus。
官方說明 Shadow Pokémon 可使用星塵與糖果淨化；因此 Purified 只由同 exact form 已確認 Shadow 狀態推導，不從普通版或 PvPoke identity 推定。

boundary: Every release state is exact-form scoped. All 38 ordinary forms are released, but ordinary release never propagates to Shadow, Purified, Mega, Dynamax, or Gigantamax. Serebii roster absence stays UNKNOWN. Shadow Axew is direct positive event evidence; Shadow Fraxure and Haxorus are evolution-derived only through the official Shadow evolution mechanic. Seasonal and gender forms never inherit another form's Shadow or special-variant status. PvPoke presence never implies release. Mega Eelektross and Mega Chandelure explicit Released: No does not affect their ordinary forms. Dynamax/Gigantamax remain UNKNOWN without positive exact-form evidence.
